Title: Scrapbook
Description: A pocket scrapbook that collects the pamphlets, photos and written notes you pick up into one book that costs zero inventory slots. Pull a fresh copy of any page back out for a picture frame or a friend.
HowTo: Pick up pamphlets, photos or written notes and keep them in your inventory.
Press Store pages to paste everything you're carrying into it.
Page through with Prev/Next and the Prints/Papers tabs.
Press Take a copy to pull a page back out — the original stays in the book.
Notes: Your book survives map wipes — it's a keepsake.
